prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A compact ICON SYMBOL representing the available hand tools in a Mars making game, rather than a literal large tool kit or box. Just a simple crossed open-ended spanner and short screwdriver, arranged as one clear conventional tools symbol, with natural silhouettes. Modest brushed steel heads and one restrained dark teal grip; a touch of the warm painterly cream-and-metal Mars art style from the references. Clear broad shapes with minimal detail, readable when the entire symbol is only 44 CSS pixels across. No container, toolkit box, case, tray, bag, drill, inventory pile, background disc, badge, text or scenery. Do not depict an elaborate manufactured product. The icon is not a scale model: it stands for access to workshop tools in general, in the same manner as the steel stock symbol. Centered isolated image with true transparency, no surrounding floor and no cast floor shadow.
